payload.blocks: Landing phase 7 (heads-stable-and-able/p07, reviewed, 18 tests green) and any other land that changes only core/skills sources.
payload.headline: Add core/** to land.regenerate.when so a skill-only land rebuilds the mutation census?

parts.cause: land.regenerate.when misses core/**, so the door never rebuilds the census for a skill-only land; 080212601 was a hand rebuild of the same gap. The census file is outside this plan's footprint, so the lead cannot rebuild it on the branch.

options.gain: every skill land rebuilds the census itself; no more hand rebuilds
options.harm: the regenerate step runs on skill lands too (a few seconds)
options.label: Add core/** to land.regenerate.when

options.cost: one footprint edit plus a unit
options.does: add packages/git/contracts/mutation-census.v1.json; a unit rebuilds it on the branch
options.harm: the gap stays for every other plan
options.label: Widen this plan's footprint by the census file

parts.recommendation: Add core/** to land.regenerate.when; the lead then lands p07 as it is.

scope.forbids: Hand edits of the mutation census.

parts.what: fgos land heads-stable-and-able/p07 failed its first gate: test/setup/git-mutation-census.test.mjs 'mutation census was not built from this payload: core/skills/_shared/friction-capture.md, core/skills/fgos-lead/SKILL.md, core/skills/fgos-supervisor/SKILL.md'. The census (packages/git/contracts/mutation-census.v1.json) hashes core/skills sources, but land.regenerate in .fgos/config.yaml runs only when a landed path matches src/**, apps/**, packages/**, bin/** or scripts/**.
